description: 2 tactical challenges for Black in the Latvian Gambit. Play 2...f5!? and hunt the white king.

drills.briefExplanation: 2...f5! 3.exf5 e4 4.Ne5 Nf6 — the Latvian: open lines and a kingside attack for the pawn.
drills.description: Black to play. White plays 2.Nf3 — counter with the Latvian 2...f5!.
drills.explanation: The Latvian Gambit: Black answers 2.Nf3 with the audacious 2...f5!, a King's Gambit with colors reversed. After 3.exf5 e4 4.Ne5 Nf6 Black has the classic gambit setup — open f-file, central wedge, and direct threats against White's king. Sound? Barely. Fun and dangerous? Absolutely.
drills.name: The Latvian Strike

drills.briefExplanation: 4...Nf6 5.Qe2 Qe7 6.d4 d5! — develop, neutralize, then break in the center.
drills.description: Black to play. White centralized 4.Ne5 — develop and neutralize 5.Qe2.
drills.explanation: After 4.Ne5 Nf6 White often tries 5.Qe2, eyeing e4. Black answers 5...Qe7! — developing with tempo and keeping the gambit tension. After 6.d4 Black strikes with 6...d5!, opening the center while the e4 wedge cramps White. Calm development, then the thematic break.
drills.name: Meeting Qe2

name: Latvian Gambit — Black Tactics
